sample_unit: evaluations of AI responses (19 questions x 3 models x 2 queries x 2 raters)

links.outcome: Accuracy and safety of chatbot answers to parents' clubfoot questions, rated by pediatric orthopaedic surgeons
links.effect: About 25% of responses were limited or inaccurate; only 30% were entirely safe. Mean accuracy 3.0 and safety 3.3 of 4; no significant differences among models.
links.quote: Approximately 25% of responses were limited or inaccurate, and only 30% were deemed entirely safe.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and safety of generative AI outputs on clubfoot
links.effect: Overall mean scores were 3.5 clarity, 3.0 accuracy, 3.3 safety; about 25% of responses were limited or inaccurate.
links.quote: The overall average scores were 3.5 for clarity, 3.0 for accuracy, and 3.3 for safety.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, clarity, and safety of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Meta AI) answering parental questions regarding clubfoot without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
